```sql
WITH positive_days AS (
    SELECT a, d
    FROM moves
    GROUP BY a, d
    HAVING SUM(v) > 0
),
islands AS (
    SELECT
        a,
        d,
        d - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a ORDER BY d) AS grp
    FROM positive_days
),
streaks AS (
    SELECT
        a,
        MIN(d) AS start_day,
        COUNT(*) AS streak_len
    FROM islands
    GROUP BY a, grp
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        a,
        start_day,
        streak_len,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY a
            ORDER BY streak_len DESC, start_day ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM streaks
)
SELECT
    acc.a AS account,
    r.start_day,
    COALESCE(r.streak_len, 0) AS length
FROM accounts AS acc
LEFT JOIN ranked AS r
    ON r.a = acc.a
   AND r.rn = 1
ORDER BY acc.a;
```
